articles.summary: Launched Niagen™ Plus Niagen™ Liquid At-Home Injections Launched Niagen NanoCloud™, the first dermatologist-tested topical product Launched “Don’t Get Old. Age Better.®,” a new brand campaign Net sales of $27.2 million, including $23.3 million from Tru Niagen Generated $2.6 million of operating cash flow Niagen Bioscience, Inc. (NASDAQ:NAGE), the global authority on NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) with a focus on the science of healthy aging, today announced its operational updates and financial results for the third quarter of 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Financial and Business Highlights Total net sales of $27.2 million, including $23.3 million from Tru Niagen®. Direct to consumer sales on the Company’s website grew by 13% year-over-year. Gross margin of 62.9%, which the Company believes reflects the strength of its operational foundation. Net loss of $1.2 million, with basic and diluted loss per share of $(0.01). Adjusted EBITDA, a non-GAAP measure, was positive at $0.5
articles.title: Niagen Bioscience, Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
